text: Stoneweg is a Geneva-headquartered global alternative-investment group founded in 2015 by Jaume Sabater. It is part of SWI Group, formed in 2025 by the merger of Stoneweg and Icona Capital and listed on Euronext Amsterdam.
short: Stoneweg is part of SWI Group, the listed group formed by the 2025 merger of Stoneweg and Icona Capital.
